description: Advisory committees can approve spending up to $2,000.
Committees must submit annual budgets by October 1.

chips.text: A committee funded a "bird straight thing" despite Council not approving its budget.

How will committees accommodate ad-hoc funding requests from external groups?
Administration will provide background on existing grants for funding requests.
